mapper.select: select m.member_id, m.id, m.password, m.name AS member_name, m.nickname, m.gender, m.birthday, m.phone, m.point, m.role, m.team_id, t.team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.league, t.logo, t.head_coach, t.stadium, t.location from member m INNER JOIN team t ON m.team_id = t.team_id where m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member(id, password, name, gender, birthday, nickname, team_id, role, phone, point) VALUES(#{id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{nickname}, #{teamDto.teamId}, #{role}, #{phone}, #{point})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{nickname}
SELECT nickname FROM member WHERE nickname = #{nickname}

select m.member_id, m.id, m.password, m.name AS member_name, m.nickname, m.gender, m.birthday, m.phone, m.point, m.role, m.team_id, t.team_id, t.name AS team_name, t.league, t.logo, t.head_coach, t.stadium, t.location from member m INNER JOIN team t ON m.team_id = t.team_id where m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, birthday = #{birthday}, phone = #{phone} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
Update member SET password = #{password} where member_id = #{memberId}
Update member SET team_id = #{teamDto.teamId} where member_id = #{memberId}
Update member SET nickname = #{nickname} where member_id = #{memberId}
Update member set point = point + 200 where member_id = #{memberId}
